top_categories.workout_context: Gran Fondo Badlands' mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 101, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Badlands. Train it until it feels boring.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At Gran Fondo Badlands, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Badlands. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 101 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Badlands' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 101 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 101 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Gran Fondo Badlands. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
101 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Badlands' mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Badlands’s 101 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Gran Fondo Badlands. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Gran Fondo Badlands rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and G Spot to prepare you for 101 miles of mixed terrain in Drumheller, Alberta, Canada.
